question: In human body, which of the following types of veins are located within muscle tissue and have a corresponding artery nearby?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deep veins.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Persons can further classify systemic veins into either:** Deep veins.**
 
• These veins generally have a corresponding artery close by and are in muscle tissue.
 
• These veins may have a **one-way valve to stop blood from flowing backwards.**
 
• The deep veins of the upper edge involve** the paired ulnar, radial, and interosseous veins **in the **forearm; paired brachial veins of the upper arm; and axillary vein**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab4e91c73ece20dbefaaa2759187a2909635f8bf824670987aab8ea6cb54458f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superficial veins** are seemingly those that are found close to the human body's surface.
 
• **Pulmonary veins** are blood vessels that **transfer oxygen-rich blood from human lungs to human heart**.
 
• **​Systemic venous system** begin out as the** network of venules** that coalesce to form increasingly larger diameter veins.
